name: ffmpeg-version-recorded
find:
- name: Record the ffmpeg version this leg ran against
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo "### ffmpeg on ${{ runner.os }} (${{ runner.arch }})"
            echo '```'
            ffmpeg -version | head -n 1
            ffprobe -version | head -n 1
            echo '```'
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

      # POSTROLL_REQUIRE_FFMPEG
breaks: one leg discards the ffmpeg version it ran against, so a red Mac leg cannot be attributed: our own change and ffmpeg having moved underneath us look identical (#552)
